verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR. It detects agent-authored PRs and routes them to a different model (Claude-written code reviewed by GPT and vice versa). It also exposes CLI review that coding agents can run on their own code, a 0-5 merge-safety score, a parallel agent swarm, TREX runtime sandbox testing, and Kubernetes horizontal scaling for volume. A community user at an employer confirms it catches real issues before human review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of review quality specifically on agent-authored PRs at high volume, and benchmarks of catch rate or throughput.
